Sales Calls Suck. Don't Remove Them!
outliers.description:
Do personal trainers still need sales calls to sell online coaching? @jamessmith says no. He's half right.

He's right that the discovery call is the worst part of the job. He's wrong that a beginner can replace it with a landing page.

Send 30 people to a page and you'll close one, if you're lucky, and it has to be cheap. Get the same 30 into a conversation and you close ten times more, at ten times the price.

So keep the conversation. Delete the pitch.

Free 3-week program first. They put their email in, they train, the numbers move: 10 → 15 push-ups, 3,000 → 8,000 steps, waist 120 → 115.

Then a review call. Not a sales call. You look at what changed and show them the next step. Nobody gets convinced. They already believe it, because they did it.
